v.t: Saad. By the renowned Quran
v.l: Sad Wa Al-Qur'ani Dhi Adh-Dhikri

v.t: Those who disbelieve are steeped in arrogance and defiance
v.l: Bali Al-Ladhina Kafaru Fi `Izzatin Wa Shiqaqin

v.t: How many generations have We destroyed before them? They cried out when it was too late to escape
v.l: Kam 'Ahlakna Min Qablihim Min Qarnin Fanadaw Walata Hina Manasin

v.t: And they marveled that a warner has come to them from among them. The disbelievers said, “This is a lying magician.”
v.l: Wa `Ajibu 'An Ja'ahum Mundhirun Minhum Wa Qala Al-Kafiruna Hadha Sahirun Kadhabun

v.t: “Did he turn all the gods into one God? This is something strange.”
v.l: Aja`ala Al-'Alihata 'Ilahaan Wahidaan 'Inna Hadha Lashay'un `Ujabun

v.t: The notables among them announced: “Go on, and hold fast to your gods. This is something planned
v.l: Wa Antalaqa Al-Mala'u Minhum 'Ani Amshu Wa Asbiru `Ala 'Alihatikum 'Inna Hadha Lashay'un Yuradu

v.t: We never heard of this in the former faith. This is nothing but a fabrication
v.l: Ma Sami`na Bihadha Fi Al-Millati Al-'Akhirati 'In Hadha 'Illa Akhtilaqun

v.t: Was the message sent down to him, out of all of us?” In fact, they are doubtful of My warning. In fact, they have not yet tasted My punishment
v.l: A'uunzila `Alayhi Adh-Dhikru Min Baynina Bal Hum Fi Shakkin Min Dhikri Bal Lamma Yadhuqu `Adhabi

v.t: Or do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord—the Majestic, the Giver
v.l: Am `Indahum Khaza'inu Rahmati Rabbika Al-`Azizi Al-Wahhabi

v.t: Or do they possess the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend the ropes
v.l: Am Lahum Mulku As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa Ma Baynahuma Falyartaqu Fi Al-'Asbabi

v.t: An army of confederates with be defeated there
v.l: Jundun Ma Hunalika Mahzumun Mina Al-'Ahzabi

v.t: Before them the people of Noah denied the truth; as did Aad, and Pharaoh of the Stakes
v.l: Kadhabat Qablahum Qawmu Nuhin Wa `Adun Wa Fir`awnu Dhu Al-'Awtadi

v.t: And Thamood, and the people of Lot, and the dwellers of the Woods—these were the confederates
v.l: Wa Thamudu Wa Qawmu Lutin Wa 'Ashabu Al-'Aykati 'Ula'ika Al-'Ahzabu

v.t: None of them but denied the messengers, so My retribution was deserved
v.l: In Kullun 'Illa Kadhaba Ar-Rusula Fahaqqa `Iqabi

v.t: These can expect only a single scream, from which there is no recovery
v.l: Wa Ma Yanzuru Ha'uula' 'Illa Sayhatan Wahidatan Ma Laha Min Fawaqin

v.t: And they say, “Our Lord, hasten Your writ upon us, before the Day of Account.”
v.l: Wa Qalu Rabbana `Ajjil Lana Qittana Qabla Yawmi Al-Hisabi

v.t: Be patient in the face of what they say, and mention Our servant David, the resourceful. He was obedient
v.l: Asbir `Ala Ma Yaquluna Wa Adhkur `Abdana Dawuda Dha Al-'Aydi 'Innahu 'Awwabun

v.t: We committed the mountains to glorify with him, in the evening and at daybreak
v.l: Inna Sakhkharna Al-Jibala Ma`ahu Yusabbihna Bil-`Ashiyi Wa Al-'Ishraqi

v.t: And the birds, gathered together. All obedient to him
v.l: Wa At-Tayra Mahshuratan Kullun Lahu 'Awwabun

v.t: And We strengthened his kingdom, and gave him wisdom and decisive speech
v.l: Wa Shadadna Mulkahu Wa 'Ataynahu Al-Hikmata Wa Fasla Al-Khitabi

v.t: Has the story of the two disputants reached you? When they scaled the sanctuary
v.l: Wa Hal 'Ataka Naba'u Al-Khasmi 'Idh Tasawwaru Al-Mihraba

v.t: When they entered upon David, and he was startled by them. They said, “Do not fear. Two disputants; one of us has wronged the other; so judge between us fairly, and do not be biased, and guide us to the straight way.”
v.l: Idh Dakhalu `Ala Dawuda Fafazi`a Minhum Qalu La Takhaf Khasmani Bagha Ba`đuna `Ala Ba`đin Fahkum Baynana Bil-Haqqi Wa La Tushtit Wa Ahdina 'Ila Sawa'i As-Sirati

v.t: “This brother of mine has ninety nine ewes, and I have one ewe, and he said, ‘Entrust it to me,’ and he pressured me with words.”
v.l: Inna Hadha 'Akhi Lahu Tis`un Wa Tis`una Na`jatan Wa Liya Na`jatun Wahidatun Faqala 'Akfilniha Wa `Azzani Fi Al-Khitabi

v.t: He said, “He has done you wrong by asking your ewe in addition to his ewes. Many partners take advantage of one another, except those who believe and do good deeds, but these are so few.” David realized that We were testing him, so he sought forgiveness from his Lord, and fell down to his knees, and repented
v.l: Qala Laqad Zalamaka Bisu'uali Na`jatika 'Ila Ni`ajihi Wa 'Inna Kathiraan Mina Al-Khulata'i Layabghi Ba`đuhum `Ala Ba`đin 'Illa Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Wa Qalilun Ma Hum Wa Zanna Dawudu 'Annama Fatannahu Fastaghfara Rabbahu Wa Kharra Raki`aan Wa 'Anaba

v.t: So We forgave him that. And for him is nearness to Us, and a good place of return
v.l: Faghafarna Lahu Dhalika Wa 'Inna Lahu `Indana Lazulfa Wa Husna Ma'abin

v.t: “O David, We made you a ruler in the land, so judge between the people with justice, and do not follow desire, lest it diverts you from God’s path. Those who stray from God’s path will have a painful punishment, for having ignored the Day of Account.”
v.l: Ya Dawudu 'Inna Ja`alnaka Khalifatan Fi Al-'Arđi Fahkum Bayna An-Nasi Bil-Haqqi Wa La Tattabi`i Al-Hawa Fayuđillaka `An Sabili Allahi 'Inna Al-Ladhina Yađilluna `An Sabili Allahi Lahum `Adhabun Shadidun Bima Nasu Yawma Al-Hisabi
w: for it will lead you astray

v.t: We did not create the heaven and the earth and everything between them in vain. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve—so woe to those who disbelieve because of the Fire
v.l: Wa Ma Khalaqna As-Sama'a Wa Al-'Arđa Wa Ma Baynahuma Batilaan Dhalika Zannu Al-Ladhina Kafaru Fawaylun Lilladhina Kafaru Mina An-Nari

v.t: Or are We to treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like those who make trouble on earth? Or are We to treat the pious like the shameless
v.l: Am Naj`alu Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Kalmufsidina Fi Al-'Arđi 'Am Naj`alu Al-Muttaqina Kalfujjari

v.t: A blessed Book that We sent down to you, that they may ponder its Verses, and for those with intelligence to take heed
v.l: Kitabun 'Anzalnahu 'Ilayka Mubarakun Liyaddabbaru 'Ayatihi Wa Liyatadhakkara 'Ulu Al-'Albabi

v.t: And We granted David, Solomon, an excellent servant. He was penitent
v.l: Wa Wahabna Lidawuda Sulaymana Ni`ma Al-`Abdu 'Innahu 'Awwabun

v.t: When the beautiful horses were paraded before him in the evening
v.l: Idh `Uriđa `Alayhi Bil-`Ashiyi As-Safinatu Al-Jiyadu

v.t: He said, “I have preferred the love of niceties to the remembrance of my Lord—until it disappeared behind the veil
v.l: Faqala 'Inni 'Ahbabtu Hubba Al-Khayri `An Dhikri Rabbi Hatta Tawarat Bil-Hijabi

v.t: Bring them back to me.” And he began caressing their legs and necks
v.l: Rudduha `Alayya Fatafiqa Mashaan Bis-Suqi Wa Al-'A`naqi

v.t: We tested Solomon, and placed a body on his throne; then he repented
v.l: Wa Laqad Fatanna Sulaymana Wa 'Alqayna `Ala Kursiyihi Jasadaan Thumma 'Anaba

v.t: He said, “My Lord, forgive me, and grant me a kingdom never to be attained by anyone after me. You are the Giver.”
v.l: Qala Rabbi Aghfir Li Wa Hab Li Mulkaan La Yanbaghi Li'hadin Min Ba`di 'Innaka 'Anta Al-Wahhabu

v.t: So We placed the wind at his service, blowing gently by his command, wherever he directed
v.l: Fasakhkharna Lahu Ar-Riha Tajri Bi'amrihi Rukha'an Haythu 'Asaba

v.t: And the demons—every builder and diver
v.l: Wa Ash-Shayatina Kulla Banna'in Wa Ghawwasin

v.t: And others fettered in chains
v.l: Wa 'Akharina Muqarranina Fi Al-'Asfadi

v.t: “This is Our gift; so give generously, or withhold; without account.”
v.l: Hadha `Ata'uuna Famnun 'Aw 'Amsik Bighayri Hisabin

v.t: For him is nearness to Us, and a beautiful resort
v.l: Wa 'Inna Lahu `Indana Lazulfa Wa Husna Ma'abin

v.t: And mention Our servant Job, when he called out to his Lord, “Satan has afflicted me with hardship and pain.”
v.l: Wa Adhkur `Abdana 'Ayyuba 'Idh Nada Rabbahu 'Anni Massani Ash-Shaytanu Binusbin Wa `Adhabin

v.t: “Stamp with your foot—here is cool water to wash with, and to drink.”
v.l: Arkuđ Birijlika Hadha Mughtasalun Baridun Wa Sharabun
w: (is a spring of) water to bathe

v.t: And We restored his family for him, and their like with them; as a mercy from Us, and a lesson for those who possess insight
v.l: Wa Wahabna Lahu 'Ahlahu Wa Mithlahum Ma`ahum Rahmatan Minna Wa Dhikra Li'wli Al-'Albabi

v.t: “Take with your hand a bundle, and strike with it, and do not break your oath.” We found him patient. What an excellent servant! He was obedient
v.l: Wa Khudh Biyadika Đighthaan Fađrib Bihi Wa La Tahnath 'Inna Wa Jadnahu Sabiraan Ni`ma Al-`Abdu 'Innahu 'Awwabun

v.t: And mention Our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—endowed with ability and vision
v.l: Wa Adhkur `Ibadana 'Ibrahima Wa 'Ishaqa Wa Ya`quba 'Uli Al-'Aydi Wa Al-'Absari

v.t: We distinguished them with a distinct quality: the remembrance of the Home
v.l: Inna 'Akhlasnahum Bikhalisatin Dhikra Ad-Dari

v.t: To Us they are among the chosen, the outstanding
v.l: Wa 'Innahum `Indana Lamina Al-Mustafayna Al-'Akhyari

v.t: And mention Ishmael, Elisha, and Ezekiel; all are among the outstanding
v.l: Wa Adhkur 'Isma`ila Wa Al-Yasa`a Wa Dha Al-Kifli Wa Kullun Mina Al-'Akhyari

v.t: This is a reminder. The devout will have a good place of return
v.l: Hadha Dhikrun Wa 'Inna Lilmuttaqina Lahusna Ma'abin

v.t: The Gardens of Eden, with their doors wide-open for them
v.l: Jannati `Adnin Mufattahatan Lahumu Al-'Abwabu

v.t: Relaxing therein, and calling for abundant fruit and beverage
v.l: Muttaki'ina Fiha Yad`una Fiha Bifakihatin Kathiratin Wa Sharabin

v.t: With them will be attendants with modest gaze, of same age
v.l: Wa `Indahum Qasiratu At-Tarfi 'Atrabun

v.t: This is what you are promised for the Day of Account
v.l: Hadha Ma Tu`aduna Liyawmi Al-Hisabi

v.t: Such is Our bounty, inexhaustible
v.l: Inna Hadha Larizquna Ma Lahu Min Nafadin

v.t: All This. But the transgressors will have a miserable return
v.l: Hadha Wa 'Inna Lilttaghina Lasharra Ma'abin

v.t: Hell; in which they will roast; what a miserable abode
v.l: Jahannama Yaslawnaha Fabi'sa Al-Mihadu

v.t: All this. Let them taste it—boiling and bitter cold
v.l: Hadha Falyadhuquhu Hamimun Wa Ghassaqun

v.t: And similar torments of diverse kinds
v.l: Wa 'Akharu Min Shaklihi 'Azwajun

v.t: “This is a crowd rushing headlong with you.” There is no welcome for them. They will be scorched by the Fire
v.l: Hadha Fawjun Muqtahimun Ma`akum La Marhabaan Bihim 'Innahum Salu An-Nari

v.t: They will say, “But it is you! There is no welcome for you! It is you who brought it upon us! What a miserable end!”
v.l: Qalu Bal 'Antum La Marhabaan Bikum 'Antum Qaddamtumuhu Lana Fabi'sa Al-Qararu

v.t: They will say, “Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us, give him double torment in the Fire.”
v.l: Qalu Rabbana Man Qaddama Lana Hadha Fazid/hu `Adhabaan Đi`faan Fi An-Nari

v.t: And they will say, “What is it with us that we do not see men we used to count among the wicked
v.l: Wa Qalu Ma Lana La Nara Rijalaan Kunna Na`udduhum Mina Al-'Ashrar

v.t: Did we take them for mockery, or have our eyes swerved from them
v.l: Attakhadhnahum Sikhriyaan 'Am Zaghat `Anhumu Al-'Absaru

v.t: This is certainly true—the feuding of the people of the Fire
v.l: Inna Dhalika Lahaqqun Takhasumu 'Ahli An-Nari

v.t: Say, “I am only a warner, and there is no god except God—the One, the Conqueror
v.l: Qul 'Innama 'Ana Mundhirun Wa Ma Min 'Ilahin 'Illa Allahu Al-Wahidu Al-Qahharu

v.t: The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; the Mighty, the Forgiver.”
v.l: Rabbu As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa Ma Baynahuma Al-`Azizu Al-Ghaffaru

v.t: Say, “It is a message of great importance
v.l: Qul Huwa Naba'un `Azimun

v.t: From which you are turning away
v.l: Antum `Anhu Mu`riđuna

v.t: I have no knowledge of the Highest Assembly as they dispute
v.l: Ma Kana Liya Min `Ilmin Bil-Mala'i Al-'A`la 'Idh Yakhtasimuna

v.t: It is only revealed to me that I am a clear warner.”
v.l: In Yuha 'Ilayya 'Illa 'Annama 'Ana Nadhirun Mubinun

v.t: Your Lord said to the angels, “I am creating a human being from clay
v.l: Idh Qala Rabbuka Lilmala'ikati 'Inni Khaliqun Basharaan Min Tinin

v.t: When I have formed him, and breathed into him of My spirit, fall prostrate before him
v.l: Fa'idha Sawwaytuhu Wa Nafakhtu Fihi Min Ruhi Faqa`u Lahu Sajidina

v.t: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them
v.l: Fasajada Al-Mala'ikatu Kulluhum 'Ajma`una

v.t: Except for Satan. He was too proud, and one of the faithless
v.l: Illa 'Iblisa Astakbara Wa Kana Mina Al-Kafirina

v.t: He said, “O Satan, what prevented you from prostrating before what I created with My Own hands? Are you too proud, or were you one of the exalted?”
v.l: Qala Ya 'Iblisu Ma Mana`aka 'An Tasjuda Lima Khalaqtu Biyadayya 'Astakbarta 'Am Kunta Mina Al-`Alina

v.t: He said, “I am better than he; You created me from fire, and You created him from clay.”
v.l: Qala 'Ana Khayrun Minhu Khalaqtani Min Narin Wa Khalaqtahu Min Tinin

v.t: He said, “Then get out of here! You are an outcast
v.l: Qala Fakhruj Minha Fa'innaka Rajimun

v.t: And My curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment.”
v.l: Wa 'Inna `Alayka La`nati 'Ila Yawmi Ad-Dini

v.t: He said, “Lord, defer me until the Day they are resurrected.”
v.l: Qala Rabbi Fa'anzirni 'Ila Yawmi Yub`athuna

v.t: He said, “You are one of those deferred
v.l: Qala Fa'innaka Mina Al-Munzarina

v.t: Until the Day of the Time Appointed.”
v.l: Ila Yawmi Al-Waqti Al-Ma`lumi

v.t: He said, “By Your majesty, I will seduce them all
v.l: Qala Fabi`izzatika La'ughwiyannahum 'Ajma`ina

v.t: Except for your loyal servants among them.”
v.l: Illa `Ibadaka Minhumu Al-Mukhlasina

v.t: He said, “The truth is, and I say the truth
v.l: Qala Falhaqqu Wa Al-Haqqa 'Aqulu

v.t: I will fill Hell with you, and with every one of them who follows you.”
v.l: La'amla'anna Jahannama Minka Wa Mimman Tabi`aka Minhum 'Ajma`ina

v.t: Say, “I ask of you no wage for this, and I am not a pretender
v.l: Qul Ma 'As'alukum `Alayhi Min 'Ajrin Wa Ma 'Ana Mina Al-Mutakallifina

v.t: It is but a reminder to mankind
v.l: In Huwa 'Illa Dhikrun Lil`alamina

v.t: And you will know its message after a while.”
v.l: Wa Lata`lamunna Naba'ahu Ba`da Hinin
